name: ai-assistant-android
description: Offline-first Android AI assistant: on-device chat (Qwen2.5-0.5B via wllama/WASM, no server), a local code-generation engine that turns a task description into a working multi-file project in Python/JS/Java/Kotlin/Bash, optional GitHub login (Device Flow) to push generated projects, and static programming lessons. Built via GitHub Actions CI.

scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:js
scripts.prepare:apk: npm run fetch:model && npm run build
